basic_details.short_information: Andrew Yule & Company Limited (AYCL) has published the Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) Notification 2026 under Advertisement No. 2026/10. content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.andrewyule.com. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AYCL Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the AYCL Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) post is 16th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates in Plantation Management, Engineering, Agriculture, Bio-Science, Science, Arts, or Commerce. A postgraduate degree or diploma in Marketing Management, Management, or Agricultural Science is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) position is 70 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,44,000/- per month for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the AYCL Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy for the post of Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) in Andrew Yule & Company.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) post will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Senior Expert (Tea Marketing) position.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and download the application form from the official website of Andrew Yule & Company, which is https://www.andrewyule.com.
